g.text: Own Authentik instance, pinned version, own logical database.
Confidential web client; authorization code with S256 PKCE (a policy requires it).
Enrollment by invitation; email verified; passkey or TOTP always required.
email_verified is true only while the address equals the verified address.
The backend reaches Authentik inside the Docker network (OIDC_INTERNAL_BASE_URL),
sending the public Host and scheme; Authentik trusts them only from the backend.
Fixed Host/proto and trusted client IP
Store hashed state + browser binding, nonce, PKCE
Sign-in flow: passkey, or password + second factor
Redirect with code + state to the exact callback
Redeem code with confidential client + verifier
Validate signature, exact issuer, audience, nonce and claims;
Login never creates Users (accounts for new people come with tenants).
A verified email links the identity to a pre-provisioned User once;
an unknown or unverified person gets the generic failure and no session.
Keep the ID token only for sign-out
GET SPA and /api with session cookie
Application data only; no provider token
logoutUrl with id_token_hint and the exact return address
Invalidation flow ends the Authentik session
